marketing.heroTitle: Cikakken tsarin fonetik da makarantarku za ta iya <grad>fara koyarwa gobe da safe</grad>.
marketing.heroBody: Ku tantance kowane yaro ta intanet, ku raba su rukuni bisa mataki, ku koyar da kayan aiki {{resources}}+ da aka shirya a kan hanya mai matakai {{steps}} da manyan matakai 8. Babu buƙatar tara littattafai. Babu tsara darasi daga farko.

marketing.bookTypesBody: Kowane mataki an haɗa shi da littafin da ya dace daidai — don haka yara suna karanta kalmomin da za su iya warwarewa kawai.
marketing.soundBooksBody: Gabatar da kowane sabon sauti da hoto na gaske mai ɗaukar hankali — littafin hoto da kuma kayan koyon fonetik.
marketing.blendingBooksBody: Gina ƙwarin gwiwar warware kalmomi da sautukan da aka tara kafin yara su gamu da su a cikin labari.
marketing.storybooksBody: Labaran da ake iya karantawa da fonetik daga sassa daban-daban na duniya, tare da ayyuka a ciki da cikakkun sigogin dijital.
marketing.dashTitle: Ku ga kowane yaro, a rukuninsa kuma a shirye don koyarwa

pathway.intro: Cikakkiyar hanyar fonetik mai matakai {{steps}} da kayan aiki {{resources}}+ masu alaƙa a cikin matakai 8. Kowane mataki yana gaya muku abin da za ku koyar, abin da za ku buga, abin da za a karanta da abin da za a motsa jiki a kai.

pathway.cycleNote: Makarantu suna amfani da lokutan tantancewa na rabin zango don tantancewa, sake raba rukuni da bibiyar ci gaba. Tsakanin lokutan, malamai suna ciyar da yara gaba a kan hanyar ta amfani da ƙwarewarsu — babu jarrabawa ta hukuma bayan kowane littafi.
pathway.flowTitle: A cikin aji — tsari a cikin mataki
pathway.flowNote: Sound Books suna gabatar da sababbin GPC (alaƙar harafi da sauti) da hotuna na gaske. Blending Books suna gina ƙwarin gwiwar warware kalmomi (L1–L5 kawai; daga L6 yara suna haɗa sautuka a cikin Storybooks). Storybooks suna amfani da sautukan a cikin labarai masu al'adu daban-daban da ake iya karantawa da fonetik, tare da motsa jiki a ciki da cikakkiyar sigar dijital.

levels.title: Matakai 8
levels.intro: Kowane mataki yana lissafa GPC, Tricky Words (kalmomi masu wuya), ƙa'idar warwarewa, da cikakken tsarin kayan aiki: Storybooks, Sound Books, Blending Books da nau'o'in takardun aiki.
levels.soundBooksList: Sound Books (hotuna na gaske · ɗaya ga kowane GPC)
levels.blendingBooksList: Blending Books (A6 · motsa jiki kafin Storybook)
levels.worksheetComponents: Abubuwan takardun aiki a wannan mataki

rules.1: Kalmomin VC ko CVC daga GPC 10. Babu tarin baƙaƙe, digraf ko haruffa biyu.
rules.2: Kalmomin CVC da CVCC masu amfani da duk GPC na harafi ɗaya da ck. An yarda da ƙarshen haruffa biyu (ff, ll, ss).
rules.3: Kalmomin CVC, CVCC da CCVC. An yarda da tarin baƙaƙe masu bin juna (stop, frog, crisp).
rules.4: Duk GPC da aka koyar har da digraf na wasali da trigraf igh. Ana gabatar da kalmomi masu gaɓa biyu da ake iya warwarewa.
rules.5: GPC da aka koyar a baya tare da raba-digraf da rubutun madadin na farko. Kalmomi masu gaɓoɓi da yawa suna ƙara zama ruwan dare.
rules.6: Cikakken tarin Phase 5 har da madadin baƙaƙe da madadin furucin grafim da aka sani.
rules.7: Cikakken tarin Phase 5 har da trigraf. Ana sa ran tsarin jumla masu sarƙaƙiya.
rules.8: Cikakken tarin GPC na Phase 5 tare da tsarin kalma na Phase 6. Sauye-sauyen ɗafa-goshi/ɗafa-ƙeya da tushe abubuwa ne na koyarwa a fili.

sentenceLengths.7: Kalmomi 8–15, jumla mai haɗaka da mai sarƙaƙiya
sentenceLengths.8: Daban-daban, har da dabarun bambanta jumla

letter-tracing.label: Bin sawun haruffa
letter-tracing.description: Grafim ɗaya-ɗaya masu kibiyoyin alkibla da ɗigon ƙarshe.

handwriting.label: Rubutun hannu (haɗawa)
handwriting.description: Haɗin kafin rubutun haɗe, tsayin haruffa na sama/ƙasa, sanin layi.

alien-words.label: Kalmomin ƙage (alien words)
alien-words.description: Haɗa sautukan kalmomin ƙage irin na PSC (Phonics Screening Check). Ana dakatar da shi bayan L6.

tricky-words.label: Motsa jikin Tricky Words
tricky-words.description: Duba, rufe, rubuta, tabbatar + bin sawu da launukan bakan gizo.

sentence-grammar.label: Ayyukan jumla da nahawu
sentence-grammar.description: Gina jumla, manyan baƙaƙe, alamomin rubutu, mahaɗa.

comprehension.label: Tambayoyin fahimta
comprehension.description: Kai tsaye, na hasashe, ma'anar kalma a cikin mahallinta.

vocab-spelling.label: Kalmomi da rubutunsu
vocab-spelling.description: Dangin kalmomi, kalmomi masu ma'ana ɗaya, sauye-sauyen ɗafa-ƙeya.

storybook-pack.label: Fakitin takardun aiki na Storybook
storybook-pack.description: Takardun A4 biyar ga kowane Storybook: farautar sauti, bin sawu/rubutu, karanta ka yi, kalmomin ƙage, rarraba sauti ko labari-da-zane.

sound-book-worksheet.label: Takardar aiki ta Sound Book
sound-book-worksheet.description: Takarda mai sauƙi ta shafi 1–2 ga kowane Sound Book: siffanta sauti, gina kalma, rarraba sauti.

sound-mat.label: Sound Mat
sound-mat.description: Jadawalin GPC mai taruwa na wannan mataki (da duk matakan baya) — ana manna shi a kan tebur lokacin karatu.

tricky-cards.label: Katunan Tricky Words
tricky-cards.description: Katunan yanka-da-manna na sababbin Tricky Words da aka gabatar a wannan mataki.

mapping.title: Daidaita manhaja
mapping.intro: Kwatankwacin ƙasa da ƙasa, tsarin kayan aiki na kowane mataki, zagayen takardun aiki, da sake tsara ƙananan matakai daga iyaye-6 → makaranta-8.
mapping.perLevelBody: Nau'o'in littattafai uku a kowane mataki — Storybooks (labarai masu zane), Sound Books (gabatarwa da hotuna na gaske, 1 ga kowane GPC), da Blending Books (motsa jiki na A6 kafin Storybook). Tare da nau'o'i 4 na fakitin takardun aiki.
mapping.lifecycleBody: Wane nau'in takardun aiki ne yake bayyana a wane mataki. Tushe: Curriculum Ledger.
mapping.remapBody: Haɗewar rumbun bayanai tana amfani da shi: layukan da ke cikin teburin books har yanzu suna ɗauke da lambobin iyaye-6. Manhajar makaranta tana fassara su nan take.
